summary.oneLiner: Bright Outdoor Media Limited is a leading player in India's OOH advertising market, with a strong presence in digital and traditional OOH advertising, and a growing portfolio of DOOH assets. The company has a diverse client base and a strong financial performance, with a revenue of ₹155 Cr and an EBITDA of ₹35 Cr in FY26. With its focus on innovation, digital transformation, and customer-centric strategies, Bright Outdoor Media is well-positioned to capitalize on the growing demand for OOH advertising in India.

business_model.title: Positioning (investor deck)
business_model.body:
- India's first listed OOH company (BSE SME), with 45+ years of experience (trusted since 1980) and 5,000+ corporate clients across FMCG, tech, auto, real estate, entertainment, BFSI and healthcare.
- Holds exclusive/monopoly advertising rights in Navi Mumbai Metro, majority of Mumbai railway stations, and the Mumbai Port Trust (MbPT) Freeway.
- Truly 360-degree execution under one roof spanning OOH, DOOH, TV, print, radio, PR, events, digital/influencer marketing and celebrity management with an in-house creative & production team.
- Among India's largest Digital LED Billboard operators, having sold 1600 Lakh+ sq. ft. of prime hoarding space till 2025 and recognized as 'Great Indian IPO Game Changer' (2024).

segment_detail.title: Segment / subsidiary detail
segment_detail.body: The company's revenue is segmented into OOH advertising (67.34%), DOOH advertising (29.39%), and other services (3.27%)

order_book.title: Order book & pipeline
order_book.body: The company has a strong order book, with a 10-year contract for Navi Mumbai Metro Line 1 advertising rights and a growing portfolio of DOOH assets.

guidance.title: Guidance / outlook
guidance.body: The company plans to expand its DOOH portfolio, invest in CRM and marketing, and strengthen its presence in mall and multiplex advertising, with a focus on sustainable advertising solutions and CSR initiatives.

growth_optionality.title: Growth verticals / optionality
growth_optionality.body: The company has growth optionality through its expansion into new markets, such as MICE services, and its focus on digital transformation and innovation.

margins.title: Margins & cost dynamics
margins.body: The company's EBITDA margin is 22.58%, with a focus on cost optimization and efficiency.

capital_allocation.title: Capital allocation
capital_allocation.body: The company's capital allocation is focused on investing in growth initiatives, such as expanding its DOOH portfolio and investing in new technologies and infrastructure.

risks.title: Risks & watch-items
risks.body: The company faces risks such as intense competition in the OOH advertising market, regulatory changes, and economic downturns.

non_obvious.title: Non-obvious takeaways
non_obvious.body: The company's focus on sustainability and CSR initiatives is a non-obvious factor that sets it apart from its competitors.

other.title: Notable from the deck
other.body: - [Shareholding] Promoter & Promoter Group hold 70% and public shareholders hold 30% of the company (as on 11-06-2026).
